sections.title: Impostazioni del modello di richiesta
paragraphs: <p><span style="font-size:small;">Use this form for quickly getting&nbsp;a quote from multiple suppliers on specific items that are not already available on contract.&nbsp; You will find separate pages in this wizard where you should complete the following:</span></p> <ul> <li><span style="font-size:small;">Compose a&nbsp;brief message to suppliers, outlining your need and telling them to respond by emailing you their quotes.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size:small;">Answer questions&nbsp;needed for the approval process.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size:small;"><span style="font-size:small;">Specify your product and/or service line items (note that there are separate pages for products and services; you can hide whichever is irrelevant).</span></span></li> <li><span style="font-size:small;">Select your suppliers (if using this process, please request bids from at least 3 suppliers).</span></li> <li><span style="font-size:small;">Submit the form.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size:small;">If you need to see the approval process or status, click the 'Form Approvals' tab at the bottom of the form request wizard.</span></p> <ul></ul>
